name: AWS IAM — Roles
description: Pull IAM roles as cloud identities (machine identities, service accounts, cross-account roles) for CIEM analysis

steps.instruction: Log into the AWS Management Console and go to IAM → Users
Create or select an IAM user and attach the IAMReadOnlyAccess managed policy
Go to Security credentials → Create access key → Choose 'Third-party service'
IAM is global. Provide a region for SigV4 signing.

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to AWS IAM. Verify your access key has IAMReadOnlyAccess permission.

transform.expr: {'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'identity_type': 'iam_role', 'role_name': record.get('RoleName', ''), 'role_id': record.get('RoleId', ''), 'arn': record.get('Arn', ''), 'account_id': (str(record.get('Arn', '')).split(':')[4] if record.get('Arn') and len(str(record.get('Arn', '')).split(':')) > 4 else ''), 'display_name': record.get('RoleName', '')}

{'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'resource_type': 'iam_role', 'identity_subtype': 'machine_identity', 'path': record.get('Path', '/'), 'description': record.get('Description', ''), 'max_session_duration': record.get('MaxSessionDuration', 3600), 'create_date': record.get('CreateDate', ''), 'last_used_date': (record.get('RoleLastUsed', {}) or {}).get('LastUsedDate', ''), 'last_used_region': (record.get('RoleLastUsed', {}) or {}).get('Region', ''), 'assume_role_policy_document': record.get('AssumeRolePolicyDocument', ''), 'permissions_boundary': (record.get('PermissionsBoundary', {}) or {}).get('PermissionsBoundaryArn', ''), 'tags': {t.get('Key', ''): t.get('Value', '') for t in (record.get('Tags') or [])}}

region.description: AWS region for SigV4 signing (IAM is a global service)
